author: Yffe
content: Stage 1b: replace the 1a UnsupportedAdt validator gate with the real ADT validator in thermite-spec/src/validator.rs. Declaration pre-pass (Validator::new) collects enums (name->variant order), variant_to_enum, struct_fields. REQ-5 check_match_exhaustiveness infers the matched enum from arm patterns and emits NonExhaustiveMatch{missing}/UnreachableArm/UnknownVariant; slice/Option matches inert (no regression). REQ-6 check_field/check_variant_ref emit UnknownField/UnknownVariant. REQ-7: Match/Field/Is/Deref stay flat built-ins in the caged walk. New SpecError variants additive. Tests: thermite-spec/tests/adt_validate.rs drives conformance/adt-validate/cases.json (3 accept, 5 reject). Gauntlet: build/test/clippy/fmt all green; lowering stays gated (1c).
